enchantment.modern_ite.fixed.desc: Wearing an enchanted chestplate prevents Exchanger Skeletons from swapping positions with you.
enchantment.modern_ite.chain.desc: Mining ore also mines connected ores, up to 27 additional blocks per level, with normal tool wear. Requires a pickaxe or war hammer of a suitable material. Incompatible with Silk Touch.
enchantment.modern_ite.slowdown.desc: Arrow hits have a chance to slow the target. Higher levels increase the chance, duration and possible Slowness strength.
enchantment.modern_ite.plucking.desc: Right-click a healthy, fully grown crop with a mattock to harvest its drops and reset it to a seedling, with normal tool wear.
enchantment.modern_ite.reaping.desc: Right-click healthy, fully grown wheat with a scythe to harvest its drops and reset it to a seedling, with normal tool wear.
enchantment.modern_ite.defenced.desc: Hold the use button with an enchanted vibranium tool to block eligible damage from the front, halving the damage at the cost of durability. Guarding has a duration limit and a cooldown.
enchantment.modern_ite.crit.desc: Increases the chance of melee critical hits and adds damage to critical hits. Higher levels increase both bonuses. Ineffective against the Zombie Boss.
enchantment.modern_ite.extend.desc: While held in the main hand, adds 0.25 blocks of block and entity interaction range per level.
enchantment.modern_ite.emergency.desc: While worn and ready, sets health to the configured amount and briefly grants Resistance II when damage leaves you at 30% health or less, or would kill you. More ready enchanted armor pieces shorten the cooldown, which only decreases while worn.
enchantment.modern_ite.conqueror.desc: Repeated melee hits against the same target gain extra damage based on previous successful hits. Higher levels increase the bonus. Ineffective against the Zombie Boss.
enchantment.modern_ite.beheading.desc: Kills with an enchanted axe have a chance to drop an extra head from skeletons, wither skeletons, zombies, creepers or players. Higher levels increase the chance.
enchantment.modern_ite.experience.desc: Kills with an enchanted weapon drop additional experience points. Higher levels grant more extra experience.
